description: Notification sent to the original submitter when an admin updates the status of, or responds to, their complaint in the University Complaints Portal.
subject: Complaint $tracking_id — status updated to $status
body:
Dear $student_name,

There is an update on the complaint you submitted to the University Complaints Portal.

Complaint Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tracking ID:    $tracking_id
Subject:        $subject
Category:       $category
Priority:       $priority
Status:         $status
Last Updated:   $updated_at
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Admin Response:
$response

What to do next:
• You can review the full history of this complaint at any time using your tracking ID in the "Track Complaint" tab of the Complaints Portal.
• If the status above is "Resolved" and you believe the issue is not fully addressed, please reply by submitting a follow-up complaint that references the tracking ID above.
• If the status is "In Progress", no further action is required from you at this time — our team is working on it.

If you did not submit this complaint, please contact the administration immediately.

Kind regards,
University Complaints Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
